sentences.text: Të shtunën tjetër, kur klubi mbaroi, Ardi mbeti pas fëmijëve të tjerë në oborrin e shkollës.
sentences.english: The next Saturday, when the club ended, Ardi stayed behind the others in the school yard.

sentences.text: Kishte rënë shi gjithë natën, dhe në oborr kishte shumë ujë.
sentences.english: It had rained all night, and in the yard there was a lot of water.

sentences.text: Pranë murit të shkollës ai dëgjoi një zë të vogël, si një kërkesë.
sentences.english: By the wall of the school he heard a small sound, like a request.

sentences.text: Ardi u ul dhe pa një qen të vogël dhe shumë të dobët, që ishte shumë i ftohtë.
sentences.english: Ardi sat down and saw a small and very thin dog, who was very cold.

sentences.text: Qeni kishte një rrip të kuq, por rripi ishte i thyer.
sentences.english: The dog had a red collar, but the collar was broken.

sentences.text: — Ku është pronari yt? — e pyeti Ardi me zë të ulët.
sentences.english: "Where is your owner?" Ardi asked him in a low voice.

sentences.text: Qeni e shikoi dhe lëvizi bishtin pak, si të thoshte: «Nuk e di.»
sentences.english: The dog looked at him and moved his tail a little, as if to say: "I do not know."

sentences.text: Ardi e dinte që gjyshja nuk do ta pranonte një qen të tretë në shtëpi.
sentences.english: Ardi knew that grandmother would not accept a third animal in the house.

sentences.text: Ajo kishte tashmë një qen të madh dhe një mace, që nuk e donte asnjë qen.
sentences.english: She already had a big dog that barked a lot, and a cat that did not like any dog.

sentences.text: Por qeni i vogël ishte shumë i ftohtë, dhe Ardi nuk kishte zemër ta lërë në shi.
sentences.english: But the little dog was very cold, and Ardi did not have the heart to leave him in the rain.

sentences.text: E vuri në çantë, mbi fletoret, dhe e mbylli çantën pak.
sentences.english: He put him in his bag, on top of the notebooks, and closed the bag a little.

sentences.text: Rruga për në shtëpi ishte e gjatë.
sentences.english: The way home was long.

sentences.text: Qeni lëvizte në çantë, dhe Ardi e mbante me të dy duart.
sentences.english: The dog moved in the bag, and Ardi held it with both hands.

sentences.text: Një grua që kalonte e pyeti: — Çfarë ke aty, djalë?
sentences.english: A woman who was passing asked him: "What have you got there, boy?"

sentences.text: — Libra, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "Books," said Ardi.

sentences.text: Në atë moment qeni bëri një zë të vogël.
sentences.english: At that moment the dog made a small sound.

sentences.text: Gruaja qeshi dhe tha: — Libra që bërtasin, është një shkollë e mirë!
sentences.english: The woman laughed and said: "Books that bark, it is a good school!"

sentences.text: Në shtëpi gjyshja po përgatiste drekën.
sentences.english: At home grandmother was preparing lunch.

sentences.text: — Ardi, pse ke një çantë që lëviz? — pyeti ajo pa u kthyer.
sentences.english: "Ardi, why do you have a bag that moves?" she asked without turning round.

sentences.text: — Është ... një libër i gjallë, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "It is ... a living book," said Ardi.

sentences.text: — Një libër që ka bisht? — tha Drita, dhe tani u kthye.
sentences.english: "A book that has a tail?" said Drita, and now she turned round.

sentences.text: Qeni e ngriti kokën nga çanta dhe e pa Dritën me sy të mëdhenj.
sentences.english: The dog raised his head from the bag and looked at Drita with big eyes.

sentences.text: Drita heshti për disa sekonda.
sentences.english: Drita was silent for a few seconds.

sentences.text: Pastaj tha: — Mos më thuaj se ke sjellë një qen të tretë në këtë shtëpi.
sentences.english: Then she said: "Do not tell me that you have brought a third animal into this house."

sentences.text: — Vetëm për sonte, gjyshe, — tha Ardi.
sentences.english: "Only for tonight, grandmother," said Ardi.

sentences.text: — Nëse e lë jashtë, ai do të vdesë nga ftohja.
sentences.english: "If I leave him outside, he will die of the cold."

sentences.text: — Çdo qen «vetëm për sonte» bëhet qen i shtëpisë, — tha gjyshja.
sentences.english: "Every dog 'only for tonight' becomes a dog of the house," said grandmother.

sentences.text: Por ajo mori një peshqir të vjetër dhe e fshiu qenin me kujdes.
sentences.english: But she took an old towel and dried the dog carefully.

sentences.text: Atë natë qeni fjeti në dhomën e Ardit, mbi një batanije.
sentences.english: That night the dog slept in Ardi's room, on a blanket.

sentences.text: Gjyshja e rregulloi batanijen e vjetër me duart e saj.
sentences.english: Grandmother arranged the old blanket with her own hands.

sentences.text: Pas një ore ai filloi të qajë me një zë të hollë dhe të trishtuar.
sentences.english: After an hour he began to cry in a thin and sad voice.

sentences.text: Gjyshja erdhi te dera me llambën në dorë.
sentences.english: Grandmother came to the door with the lamp in her hand.

sentences.text: — Ai ka frikë, — pëshpëriti Ardi.
sentences.english: "He is afraid," whispered Ardi.

sentences.text: — Është i vetëm dhe nuk e di ku është.
sentences.english: "He is alone and does not know where he is."

sentences.text: Gjyshja nuk tha asgjë.
sentences.english: Grandmother said nothing.

sentences.text: Ajo e pyeti përsëri nëse kishte ngrënë.
sentences.english: She asked again whether he had eaten.

sentences.text: Ajo u ul pranë tyre, e preku qenin pas kokës, dhe qeni heshti pas pak.
sentences.english: She sat down beside them, touched the dog on the head, and the dog fell silent after a little.

sentences.text: — Kështu bëhet, — tha ajo.
sentences.english: "That is how it is done," she said.

sentences.text: — Nuk i duhen fjalë, i duhet një dorë.
sentences.english: "He does not need words, he needs a hand."

sentences.text: — Gjyshe, a mund ta mbajmë? — pyeti Ardi.
sentences.english: "Grandmother, can we keep him?" asked Ardi.

sentences.text: — Jo, — tha ajo me zë të ulët.
sentences.english: 'No,' she said in a low voice.

sentences.text: — Ai ka një pronar që ndoshta po e kërkon sonte në rrugë.
sentences.english: "He has an owner who is perhaps looking for him in the street tonight."

sentences.text: — Nëse e kemi marrë ne, duhet ta kthejmë atje ku i takon.
sentences.english: "If we have taken him, we must give him back where he belongs."

sentences.text: Të dielën në mëngjes Ardi e mori qenin dhe shkoi te Sami.
sentences.english: On Sunday morning Ardi took the dog and went to Sam.

sentences.text: Ai kishte një ide, por nuk e dinte si ta fillonte.
sentences.english: He had an idea, but he did not know how to begin.
